title: Implement Point and Rectangle as dataclasses in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement Point(x, y) and Rectangle(x, y, width, height) as @dataclass types, plus area() and translate() helper functions.

injections.content: # TODO: implement Point and Rectangle as dataclasses

from src.shapes import Point, Rectangle, area, translate


def test_point_creation():
    p = Point(x=1.0, y=2.0)
    assert p.x == 1.0
    assert p.y == 2.0


def test_rectangle_creation():
    r = Rectangle(x=0, y=0, width=10, height=5)
    assert r.width == 10
    assert r.height == 5


def test_area():
    r = Rectangle(x=0, y=0, width=4, height=3)
    assert area(r) == 12.0


def test_translate():
    p = Point(1.0, 2.0)
    p2 = translate(p, 3.0, -1.0)
    assert p2.x == 4.0
    assert p2.y == 1.0


def test_dataclass_type():
    import dataclasses
    p = Point(x=0, y=0)
    assert dataclasses.is_dataclass(p)
